shipping-policy.title: Shipping policy
shipping-policy.content:
Order processing

Orders are generally processed within 1 to 3 business days after confirmation and payment verification. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays may be processed on the next business day.

Shipping and delivery

Estimated delivery is 5 to 10 business days from dispatch, depending on your location and courier availability. Delivery times are estimates and can vary with weather, holidays and courier delays.

Shipping charges

Any applicable charges are displayed at checkout before you complete your purchase.

Order tracking

Once your order ships, tracking details may be shared by email, SMS or other available channels.

Address accuracy

Please provide a complete and accurate address when you order.

refund-policy.title: Refund and cancellation
refund-policy.content:
Order cancellation

Orders can be cancelled only before they have been shipped. To request a cancellation, contact us as soon as possible with your order details.

Returns and replacements

For hygiene and safety reasons, beauty and personal care products are generally not eligible for return once opened or used. A return or replacement may be accepted if you received a damaged, defective or incorrect product.

Requests must be raised within 7 days of delivery with your order details and clear photographs or videos of the product and packaging.
